author: teteumac
body:
This PR removes the eight filter-specific MET histograms from METAnalyzer for all MET types and running modes. Their MonitorElement declarations, bookings, map entries and filling code are deleted, together with the unused filter-decision argument in the filling helpers. The HBHE decision used by the event selections is preserved.

  The eight dependent MET filter-efficiency histograms are also removed from DataCertificationJetMET. The cleanup includes the commented declarations, bookings and filling code for the 46 selected legacy BXm2BXm1 histograms.

  Validation: git diff --check and targeted static review passed. The review verified removal of the selected symbols, consistent helper signatures and calls, unchanged remaining bookings, and preservation of the event selections and remaining harvesting code. The CMSSW build, cmsRun and DQM/RelVal validation chain were not rerun for this revision.
title: [DQM] Remove MET filter histograms and dependent efficiencies - Round 1
